source_school: Harvard College Dean of Students Office Staff
bio: I assist the Winthrop House Resident Dean, Remei Capdevila Werning, in supporting Winthropians with administrative and academic processes and details (including things like registration, add/drop/withdrawal, change of grading basis, independent study, etc) as well as with ad board processes (such as leaves of absence and makeup exams). I assist the pre-health team with medical and dental school applications, including managing letters of recommendation. I'm also always here to assist with any questions about graduation requirements and Commencement. Please reach out or drop in with any questions or concerns! I'm an avid reader, I love to travel, and I love to cook. If you ever want recommendations of historical sites to visit around Cambridge/Boston, hit me up! Please reach out to me with any questions you have about administrative or academic processes! I'm also here to help with questions about adboard, letters of recommendation, and questions about Commencement. Community Winthrop House Role Residential Academic Coordinators
